mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(citation.id, CONCAT('provenance:', provenance.canvas_version, ':', provenance.cell_id)) AS citation_id, provenance.cell_id, provenance.provenance_ref, citation.claim_key AS statement_key, provenance.support_type, citation.state AS citation_state, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN evidence.citation_key ELSE CONCAT('unavailable:', tombstone.id) END AS citation_key, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN material.id END AS material_id, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN material.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN version.id END AS version_id, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN version.version_no END AS version_no, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN page.page_no END AS page_number, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN unit.modality END AS modality, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN material.lifecycle_state WHEN tombstone.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE' END AS source_state, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN evidence.revision_id END AS processing_revision_id, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN region.bbox_json END AS bbox_json, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(evidence.source_origin, unit.source_channel) END AS origin, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL AND unit.display_text_object_key IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS excerpt_available, CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL AND (unit.visual_object_key IS NOT NULL OR page.page_image_key IS NOT NULL) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS preview_available, CASE WHEN material.id IS NULL THEN tombstone.deleted_at END AS deleted_at ,CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN unit.display_text_object_key END AS display_text_object_key ,CASE WHEN material.id IS NOT NULL THEN unit.display_text_object_version_id END AS display_text_object_version_id FROM diagram_cell_provenance provenance JOIN diagram ON diagram.id = provenance.diagram_id AND diagram.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND diagram.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN source_citation anchor ON anchor.id = provenance.current_citation_id LEFT JOIN source_citation citation ON citation.diagram_id = anchor.diagram_id AND citation.cell_id = anchor.cell_id AND citation.canvas_version = anchor.canvas_version AND citation.owner_key = #{ownerKey} LEFT JOIN citation_evidence evidence ON evidence.citation_id = citation.id LEFT JOIN evidence_unit unit ON unit.id = evidence.evidence_id LEFT JOIN material_version version ON version.id = evidence.version_id LEFT JOIN material ON material.id = version.material_id AND material.owner_key = #{ownerKey} LEFT JOIN material_page page ON page.id = unit.page_id AND page.revision_id = evidence.revision_id LEFT JOIN evidence_region region ON region.evidence_id = unit.id AND region.ordinal = 0 LEFT JOIN citation_source_tombstone tombstone ON tombstone.citation_id = citation.id WHERE provenance.diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND provenance.cell_id = #{cellId} AND (#{provenanceRef} IS NULL OR provenance.provenance_ref = #{provenanceRef}) AND provenance.canvas_version = COALESCE(#{canvasVersion}, (SELECT state.version FROM diagram_canvas_state state WHERE state.diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND state.user_id = #{ownerKey})) ORDER BY citation.created_at, citation_key
